shortDescription: A trader first bought GSTOCK two days ago and added to the position during a rapid 20-minute price rise, spending a total of $261,000 to accumulate 12.31 million tokens at an average price of $0.02117. According to Odaily, the address is now up $51,000 and ranks among the top four GSTOCK holders.
